scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Dramatic Troupes participating in Kala Academy’s Annual Tiatr Competition
description:
The Financial Assistance to Dramatic Troupes participating in Kala Academy’s Annual Tiatr Competition is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Goa.

This scheme was launched in the year 2014 under the aegis of the Kala Academy.

The primary objective of this scheme is to promote and support the traditional art form of Tiatr in Goa.

Tiatr is a popular form of musical theatre in Goa that has deep cultural significance.

The scheme aims to encourage local dramatic troupes to participate in the annual Tiatr competition organized by the Kala Academy.

The competition is held every year and serves as a platform for showcasing the talents of various troupes.

The scheme provides financial assistance to these troupes to help cover their production costs.

The financial assistance amount is set at ₹1,00,000 for each participating troupe.

This amount is intended to support expenses related to staging the performances.

Eligible troupes can use the funds for costumes, sets, and other necessary production elements.

The scheme aims to enhance the quality of performances and encourage more participation.

The eligibility criteria for the scheme are specific and detailed.

Only registered dramatic troupes are eligible to apply for the financial assistance.

These troupes must be based in Goa and must have a history of performing Tiatr.

The troupes must also be registered with the Kala Academy.

The application process is straightforward and requires specific documentation.

Interested troupes must submit an application form to the Kala Academy.

The application form can be obtained from the official website of the Kala Academy.

Along with the application form, troupes must provide proof of registration.

They must also submit a detailed budget outlining how the funds will be used.

The deadline for submitting applications is typically set a few months before the competition.

Troupes must ensure that their applications are submitted on time to be considered for assistance.

The financial assistance is disbursed after the applications are reviewed and approved.

The Kala Academy conducts a thorough evaluation of the applications received.

This evaluation process usually takes about one month.

Once approved, the funds are released to the troupes in a single installment.

The competition itself is usually held in the month of December each year.

The exact dates for the competition may vary from year to year.

The Kala Academy announces the competition dates well in advance.

The competition is open to all registered troupes in Goa.

It is a highly anticipated event that attracts large audiences.

The Kala Academy is the implementing authority for this scheme.

The Academy operates under the Department of Art and Culture of the Government of Goa.

For any queries regarding the scheme, troupes can contact the Kala Academy directly.

The contact details for the Kala Academy are available on their official website.

The scheme has been instrumental in reviving interest in Tiatr among younger generations.

It has also helped in preserving the cultural heritage of Goa.

Over the years, the scheme has seen a significant increase in the number of participating troupes.

In the first year of the scheme, only 15 troupes applied for assistance.

By 2022, this number had increased to over 50 troupes.

This growth indicates a rising interest in Tiatr as a form of artistic expression.

The financial assistance has allowed troupes to enhance their production quality.

Many troupes have reported improved audience engagement due to better staging and performances.

The scheme not only supports the troupes financially but also boosts the local economy.

It creates opportunities for local artisans and craftsmen involved in set and costume design.

The Kala Academy also organizes workshops and training sessions for participating troupes.

These workshops focus on improving acting skills, scriptwriting, and stage management.

The initiative has garnered positive feedback from the community.

Many local artists have expressed gratitude for the support provided through this scheme.

The government has also recognized the importance of Tiatr in promoting Goan culture.

In recent years, the scheme has been included in broader cultural initiatives.

These initiatives aim to promote various forms of traditional art across the state.

The financial assistance scheme is a vital part of these efforts.

It reflects the government's commitment to supporting local art forms.

The scheme has also inspired other states to consider similar initiatives for their traditional arts.

The impact of the scheme is evident in the increased quality and quantity of performances.

The Kala Academy continues to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the scheme.

Regular feedback is collected from participating troupes to improve the process.

The government remains open to suggestions for enhancing the scheme.

Overall, the Financial Assistance to Dramatic Troupes participating in Kala Academy’s Annual Tiatr Competition is a significant initiative.

It plays a crucial role in preserving and promoting the rich cultural heritage of Goa.

The scheme has successfully fostered a vibrant community of artists dedicated to Tiatr.

It ensures that this traditional art form continues to thrive for future generations.
